title: new fortress completes restructuring cuts debt 700 million 2026 09 11
text:
Sept 11 (Reuters) - U.S. liquefied natural gas firm New Fortress Energy (NFE.O)
, opens new tab
 said on Friday it had completed its restructuring plan, bringing ​its debt down to $700 million from $5.7 billion.
The firm received ‌approvals from the UK and the U.S. in June, completing years-long efforts to reorganize mounting debt obligations as it grappled with a severe ​liquidity crunch.
